verdict.rationale: WezTerm is locally installed software that runs entirely on the user's own machines (Linux, macOS, Windows, FreeBSD, NetBSD), even as a portable copy from a thumb drive, with no vendor-hosted service involved. Its multiplexer server can also be run on the user's own remote hosts and reached through SSH or Unix domains, and the source is published on GitHub. missing for 10: an explicit open-source license citation, build-from-source documentation, and independent corroboration of self-hosting the multiplexer server.
